title: 第5章 毁尸灭迹好宝贝第6章 冷月要镇定
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
怎么可能？
三天。
仅才三天的时间，这人就突破到脱胎小成？
一定在做梦。
徐东使劲地揉着眼睛，掐着胳膊，让自己清醒点，再次打量苏凡。
修为，还是脱胎小成！
其内心，顿时不由掀起惊涛骇浪。
这人，真是废灵体？
宗门的天才弟子不计其数，最快突破脱胎小成期的也耗时五天。
换而言之。
此人的速度，已经打破最快纪录，成为宗门的第一人。
“徐师兄，怎么了？”
“是我的修炼速度太慢吗？”
换做以前，看着苏凡此刻的笑容，肯定觉得很傻，可现在，竟有些头皮发麻。
心里发怵。
慢？
特么想一巴掌抽去。
这速度还算慢，那谁的速度才算快？
小兔崽子，你想气死谁呢？
回过神。

徐东带着郁闷的心情，转身急匆匆离去。
看着徐东的背影，苏凡有些苦恼：“我不是已经收敛气息，为什么他还是能一眼看透我现在的修为？”
“因为他的修为比你强。”
“收敛气息，只有对修为比你弱的人有用，修为比你强的，照样能看透你的修为。”
大黑狗道。
“那要怎么样，才能完全隐藏修为？”
他一个废灵体，如果突破太快，肯定会引来猜疑。
魔王鼎，气血珠，可不能让人知道。
“有些特殊的灵诀，可以隐藏修为。”
大黑狗抬起爪子，按着苏凡的眉心。
苏凡立刻感觉到，一股庞大的信息，涌入脑海。
——隐匿诀！
特殊性灵诀，不具备任何杀伤力，唯一效果就是隐藏修为。
“怎么样？”
“跟着哥混，不差吧！”
大黑狗呲牙咧嘴，洋洋得意。
“不差，不差。”
苏凡连连点头。
想要什么，就给他什么，仗义。
“不好。”

大黑狗双耳一竖，低声道：“许三阴来了，赶紧把魔王鼎藏起来，小心等下搜身。”
苏凡连忙取下魔王鼎，扫视着洞府，万一等下许三阴连洞府也要搜呢？
“含着。”
情急之下，苏凡塞进大黑狗的嘴里。
就在下一刻，许三阴火燎火急的来到洞府。
content_en:
How is that possible?
Three days.
In just three days, this person has achieved a breakthrough?
Must be dreaming.
Xu Dong rubbed his eyes vigorously, pinched his arms to wake himself up, and looked at Su Fan again.
Cultivation is still a small success!
His heart suddenly couldn't help but stir up a storm.
Is this man really a useless spirit?
The sect has countless talented disciples, and the fastest one to break through the stage of rebirth took five days.
In other words.
This person's speed has broken the fastest record, becoming the first person in the sect.
"Senior Brother Xu, what's wrong?"
"Is my cultivation speed too slow?"
Before, looking at Su Fan's smile at this moment, he would have felt stupid, but now, his scalp was numb.
I felt frightened.
slow?
I really want to slap him away.
This speed is still slow, so whose speed is fast?
Little bastard, who do you want to piss off?
Come to your senses.
Xu Dong turned around and left in a hurry with a depressed mood.
Looking at Xu Dong's back, Su Fan was a little troubled: "Have I not restrained my aura, why can he still see through my current cultivation level at a glance?"
"Because his cultivation is stronger than yours."
"Condensing your aura is only useful for people whose cultivation is weaker than yours. Those whose cultivation is stronger than yours can still see through your cultivation."
The big black dog said.
"Then what can we do to completely hide our cultivation?"
He is a useless spirit, and if he breaks through too quickly, he will definitely arouse suspicion.
The Demon King Cauldron and the Qi and Blood Beads must not be known to anyone.
"There are some special spiritual techniques that can hide one's cultivation level."
The big black dog raised its paw and pressed Su Fan's forehead.
Su Fan immediately felt a huge amount of information pouring into his mind.
——Concealment Technique!
The special spirit technique does not have any lethality, and its only effect is to hide the cultivation level.
"How's it going?"
"It's not bad to hang out with my brother!"
The big black dog grinned proudly.
"Not bad, not bad."
Su Fan nodded repeatedly.
Give him whatever he wants, be righteous.
"Not good."
The big black dog's ears perked up and he whispered: "Xu Sanyin is here. Hide the Demon King's Cauldron quickly and be careful to search him later."
Su Fan quickly took down the Demon King's Cauldron and scanned the cave. What if Xu Sanyin wanted to search the cave later?
"Hold it."
In desperation, Su Fan stuffed it into the big black dog's mouth.
The next moment, Xu Sanyin came to the cave in a hurry.
